result.stdout:
hexaeight-activate — HexaEight identity activation CLI

Usage:
  hexaeight-activate [<command>]

Commands:
  newtoken      Interactive activation (default if no command is given).
                Prompts for resource name, password, license code,
                and a QR-code approval from the HexaEight Authenticator app.
                Writes env-file and hexaeight.mac to the current directory.
                On success, runs a quick license verification automatically.

  renewtoken    Renew an existing license. Prompts for the new
                license code received by email after purchase.
                Updates HEXAEIGHT_MACHINETOKEN in env-file.
                On success, runs a quick license verification automatically.

  cpucores      Print the CPU and core count this machine reports.
                Your HexaEight license must cover at least this many cores.

  verify-license
                Check the LICENSE and nothing else. One call to the platform,
                then the answer. Use this when the question is "does my
                license work?" — it is the fast one.

  verify-env    The wider health check: the license, then the approved-build
                list, then the agent's libraries against nuget.org (as
                verify-libs does), then whether this tool is current.
                Four network round trips — on a folder holding an agent the
                library check can take minutes. For the license alone use
                verify-license.

  verify-libs   Check the HexaEight libraries this machine's agent is running
                against the packages published on nuget.org. No license call,
                so it is cheap enough to run on a schedule.
                  --restore   replace any that do not match
                  --dir PATH  check a specific folder
                Exit: 0 all match, 1 a mismatch, 2 nothing found to check.

  install-agent Download the official agent for this machine and verify it
                before it can run. The expected SHA-256 shi
[truncated]

      static server.
    router:
      rebuilt on HexaEight.Bridge 1.9.24, the version the agent ships. Earlier
      routers carried 1.9.14, whose integrity rows were never captured for a
      self-contained macOS build - so on Apple Silicon the licence check failed
      while hexaeight-activate verified the same identity in the same folder.
      Linux and Windows were unaffected. Bedrock upstreams unchanged:
      translate:"bedrock" serves every Bedrock model from one entry.
    runtime:
      frozen Node toolchain: node-red, pyodide, quickjs-emscripten and Claude
      Code pinned to tested versions and installed with npm ci against a
      lockfile shipped in this package.

  verify-license
                Check the LICENSE and nothing else. One call to the platform,
                then the answer. Use this when the question is "does my

  verify-env    The wider health check: the license, then the approved-build
                list, then the agent's libraries against nuget.org (as

                library check can take minutes. For the license alone use
                verify-license.

                so it is cheap enough to run on a schedule.
